name: @loomhelm/multi-task-flow
description: Versioned Bun CLI and complete Multi-task Flow Skill runtime for Loomhelm

scripts.test: bun run build && bun test test/*.test.ts
scripts.pack:check: bun run build && bun pm pack --dry-run
scripts.publish:exact: bun run build && bun --no-install src/cli.ts release validate --version "$npm_package_version" --dist-tag "$npm_package_version" --require-provenance && bun pm publish
scripts.publish:compat: bun run build && bun --no-install src/cli.ts release validate --version "$npm_package_version" --dist-tag "${npm_config_compat_tag:?set npm_config_compat_tag=compat-vN}" --require-provenance && bun pm publish --tag "$npm_config_compat_tag"
